full_page.content:
c. 1947
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo copy of a typed original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F.M. Cap.
ST. FELIX FRIARY Route 8 HUNTINGTON, INDIANA
Dear Miss Larmee,
Thank you for your kind favor of August 2. The world is full of misunderstanding, but often God uses its mistakes to correct us, to give us the right out- look on life and its eternal destiny. Yes, I shall join my poor prayers to yours so that God may give you the happiness of always conforming your will to His. God bless you, Sincerely yours in Christ, Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Original in possession of: Mr. Peter Bercik 4 1265 Glocamora St. Mt. Clemens, MI. 48045
